content: Kevin O'Brien (Auto Loan Officer, First Community Bank) is reaching out to Lisa Freeman (Community Center Director) to offer monthly office hours for retraining program participants who want to understand small-dollar and secured lending options. Proposes one session per month at the Community Center. No application pressure — informational access, straight answers on qualification requirements. Offers to start next week.

relationship_effect.nature: Kevin is making himself useful to the community retraining pipeline in a concrete, low-cost way. This builds trust with Lisa Freeman and creates institutional visibility for Kevin within the bank's community role.

expected_response: Lisa Freeman acknowledges and either confirms space availability or proposes an alternative format for connecting enrollees with Kevin's expertise.
